facts.text: The Clear Path tuition initiative guarantees that a student will pay no more than $16,000 in tuition and mandatory fees annually after McKendree University institutional aid has been applied.

facts.text: Established in 1828 by pioneer Methodists, McKendree is the oldest college in Illinois.

sources.title: A Vibrant Experience: McKendree University
sources.quote: Established in 1828 by pioneer Methodists, McKendree is the oldest college in Illinois, and the oldest in the nation with continuous ties to the United Methodist Church.
